title: StopServiceResponse
description: Response to a stop service request, sent by the station to the app via BLE characteristic FFF4 (Notify). Confirms or rejects the service stop and provides final usage data.

result.description: Outcome of the stop service request

actualDurationSeconds.description: Actual duration the service ran in seconds, present when result is Accepted

creditsCharged.description: Credits the station computed for the service, present when result is Accepted. Advisory: the server settles its own recomputation (spec/profiles/offline/reconciliation.md 8)

errorCode.description: The registry code of the refusal: 3006 when the request's sessionId names no active session the connection established, 3007 when that session is not on the request's bay (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §3). Present when result is Rejected.

errorText.description: The registry name of errorCode, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (07-errors.md §1.3). Present when result is Rejected.

details.description: Per-occurrence context of the refusal (07-errors.md §2.3). MAY be present when result is Rejected.
